The '''''Deliverance''''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] that served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Conv" /> In [[3665 BBY]],<ref name="Gnost" /> the ''Deliverance'' was one of seventy-five vessels that were destroyed above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the sector-spanning [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]], and a [[Republic officer/Legends|Republic officer]] would remember that his brother served aboard the vessel when the ''Deliverance'' was discovered by Republic forces on Hoth during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="Conv" />
